description: Match bank statement lines against ledger lines. References are matched before amounts, because a reference is an identity and an amount is not: matching on amount first pairs two unrelated lines that happen to agree and reports the real pair as unmatched. A reference match with a disagreeing amount or date is reported with the exact difference rather than discarded. With both balances supplied, the statement is also checked for agreeing with itself. Pay 240000 atomic USDC on Base via exact x402. MCP does not pay; it provides a challenge handoff.

closing_balance.description: The statement closing balance. Supplied with the opening balance, the statement is checked for footing. A decimal string is preferred, because a JSON number cannot hold most two-place decimals exactly and the digits may already differ from what was written by the time they arrive. A number is accepted and that risk is reported.

date_tolerance_days.description: How far apart two dates may be and still match, since settlement lags posting. Defaults to 3 and is published.

ledger.description: The corresponding ledger lines, in the same sign convention.

amount.description: Signed, as above. A decimal string is preferred, because a JSON number cannot hold most two-place decimals exactly and the digits may already differ from what was written by the time they arrive. A number is accepted and that risk is reported.

date.description: When the books recorded it. A calendar date as YYYY-MM-DD.

opening_balance.description: The statement opening balance. A decimal string is preferred, because a JSON number cannot hold most two-place decimals exactly and the digits may already differ from what was written by the time they arrive. A number is accepted and that risk is reported.

statement.description: Bank statement lines. Nothing is fetched and no system is connected, so the data supplied is the whole input.

amount.description: Signed: negative for money out. A decimal string is preferred, because a JSON number cannot hold most two-place decimals exactly and the digits may already differ from what was written by the time they arrive. A number is accepted and that risk is reported.

date.description: When the bank recorded it. A calendar date as YYYY-MM-DD.

name: bank_statement_reconciliation

complete.description: Whether everything supplied was examined. False means part of it was not, which is a different problem from something that is wrong.

finding_count.description: The true total, even when the listing is bounded.

matches.description: Per match: the amounts on each side, how many days apart, and whether it matched on reference or on amount and date.

passed.description: The same verdict under the name shared across the caller-supplied families.

reconciled.description: True only when every line on both sides matched, every matched pair agreed, and every check the caller asked for was performed.

request_id.description: Delivery request identifier; also returned in x-foundry-request-id.

title: Bank Statement Reconciliation
